transit.localDesc: Village market, mandis, and nearby town deliveries. Same-day arrival.
transit.interstateDesc: State-level distribution, wholesale markets, and supermarket supply chains.
transit.coldChainDesc: Temperature-controlled logistics for premium or perishable products. Maximum protection.

materials.bopp_desc: Allows vital oxygen exchange and prevents CO2/moisture build-up to stop anaerobic spoilage. Ideal for local delivery.
materials.ldpe_desc: Cost-optimised loose-wrap alternative. Lower barrier class but significantly cheaper. Best for local mandi-to-market same-day routes.
materials.pla_desc: Allows vital oxygen exchange and prevents CO2/moisture build-up to stop anaerobic spoilage. 100% compostable.
materials.map_desc: Locks in the right mix of gases around your produce, slowing down spoilage significantly during inter-state truck journeys.
materials.retort_desc: High-barrier aluminium and nylon layers withstand extreme heat and pressure. Offers 1+ year shelf life without refrigeration.
materials.hdpe_desc: Extremely tough, puncture-resistant woven bag. Ideal for bulk grains and dry staples in non-climate-controlled local transport.
materials.alu_desc: Provides an absolute barrier against moisture, oxygen, and UV light. Perfect for preventing oxidation in fat-rich foods and powders.
materials.pp_desc: Excellent twist retention and gloss. Low moisture barrier suitable for individually wrapped hard candies and dry sweets.
materials.pet_desc: Clear, glossy outer layer with strong heat-sealable inner layer. Good general-purpose barrier for daily snacks.
materials.paper_desc: Biodegradable natural packaging. Zero moisture barrier, strictly for dry, non-sensitive items in local transit.
